# Best Music Supervision Agencies, a list by EightSix

> Lists of music supervision and sync licensing agencies for advertising, published by EightSix GmbH, a sonic branding and music agency in Berlin (formerly 86Tales). EightSix appears first on every list, marked as the publisher's own agency. The other agencies follow in alphabetical order. Facts about other agencies come from their own websites and are linked in each entry. Author: Gordian Gleiss, founder and managing director of EightSix.

## Pages

- [Best music supervision agencies in Europe (2026)](https://bestmusicsupervisionagency.com/): EightSix (Berlin), Adelphoi Music, amp sound branding, Amt für Musik, Benzene, Campera Media, DLMDD, Drumstick Entertainment, Felt Music, Leland, Magma Music Agency, MassiveMusic, Mojo 3, MUSIC PLEASE, ONETUNE, Pitch & Sync, Record-Play, Scholz & Friends Sounds, Sixième Son, Sizzer, Sonicbrand, Soundtree, TONIQ Sound Agency, Tracks & Fields, TRO, Upright Music, Wake The Town, WESOUND.
- [Sync licensing agencies for advertising in Europe (2026)](https://bestmusicsupervisionagency.com/sync-licensing-agencies/): EightSix (Berlin), Adelphoi Music, amp sound branding, Amt für Musik, Benzene, Campera Media, DLMDD, Drumstick Entertainment, Leland, Magma Music Agency, MassiveMusic, Mojo 3, MUSIC PLEASE, ONETUNE, Pitch & Sync, Record-Play, Scholz & Friends Sounds, Sixième Son, Sizzer, Sonicbrand, TONIQ Sound Agency, Tracks & Fields, TRO, Upright Music, Wake The Town, WESOUND.
- [Music agencies for advertising: custom music for commercials (2026)](https://bestmusicsupervisionagency.com/advertising-music-agencies/): EightSix (Berlin), Adelphoi Music, amp sound branding, Benzene, Campera Media, Department of Noise, DLMDD, Drumstick Entertainment, Felt Music, Leland, Magma Music Agency, MassiveMusic, Mojo 3, ONETUNE, Pitch & Sync, Record-Play, Sixième Son, Sizzer, Sonicbrand, Soundtree, TONIQ Sound Agency, Tracks & Fields, TRO, Upright Music, Wake The Town, WESOUND, why do birds.

- [Music supervision agencies in Berlin (2026)](https://bestmusicsupervisionagency.com/music-supervision-agency-berlin/): EightSix (Berlin), amp sound branding, Campera Media, Drumstick Entertainment, MassiveMusic, Mojo 3, Tracks & Fields, TRO.

## EightSix in brief

- Music supervision and licensing for campaigns: SmartLicense checks rights by territory and type of use, ArtistMatch finds new artists that fit a brand's budget.
- Published price ranges for song licences in advertising: about 5,000 to 25,000 euros for emerging artists in regional advertising, from about 50,000 euros to several million for well-known songs in global campaigns.
- Sonic identities and music for Siemens Home Appliances, OTTO (music agency of record), Douglas, Radeberger, Westwing and Motel One.
- Based in Berlin, with partners and studios in Paris, London, Tokyo, Amsterdam, Cape Town, Mallorca and New York.
